prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「机器人」？
explanation: robot 的意思是机器人。

prompt: 「automatic」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: automatic 的意思是自动的。

prompt: 选择表示「预测」的单词。
explanation: 表示预测的单词是 predict。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「创新」？
explanation: innovation 的意思是创新。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「传感器」？
explanation: sensor 的意思是传感器。

prompt: 「remote」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: remote 的意思是远程的。

prompt: 选择表示「家用电器」的单词。
explanation: 表示家用电器的单词是 appliance。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「网络」？
explanation: network 的意思是网络。

prompt: The problem is ___ the sensor fails at night. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: 从句不缺成分，表语从句用 that。

prompt: The question is ___ the robot can cook. 表示“是否”，横线处填哪一个？
explanation: 表示是否用 whether。

prompt: 哪一句语序正确？

choices.text: That is why does the appliance stop
That is why stops the appliance
That is why the appliance stops
Why that is the appliance stops

explanation: 表语从句用陈述语序 the appliance stops。

prompt: What I need is ___ the network is stable. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: is 后面的从句不缺成分，用 that。

prompt: The news ___ the robot won a prize is true. that 在从句中不充当成分，横线处填哪一个？
explanation: news 的内容是一整件事，用 that 引导同位语从句。

prompt: 哪一句是同位语从句？

choices.text: The sensor that failed was new
The robot which we bought is small
The fact that the sensor failed surprised them
The prize which he won is gold

explanation: that the sensor failed 是 fact 的内容，that 不作成分。
verify: "The fact that the sensor failed surprised them"

prompt: 哪一句是定语从句而不是同位语从句？

choices.text: The report that he was late is false
The idea that robots will cook is new
The news that she won is true
The report which he wrote is short

explanation: which he wrote 里 which 作 wrote 的宾语，是定语从句。
verify: "The report which he wrote is short"

prompt: We heard the warning ___ the network might break. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: warning 的具体内容用 that 同位语从句。

prompt: 想按步骤说明机器人如何做饭，哪一句适合作为第一步？

choices.text: First, the sensor check the food
First, the sensor checking the food
First, the sensor checks the food

explanation: First 用来开始步骤。

prompt: 想说问题在于网络不稳定，哪一句合适？

choices.text: The problem is that is the network not stable
The problem is why does it stop
The problem is that the network is not stable

explanation: 表语从句用 that 加陈述语序。
verify: "The problem is that the network is not stable"

prompt: 想转述一个消息的内容，哪一句是同位语从句？

choices.text: The news that the appliance can be controlled remotely is exciting
The appliance that we bought is remote
The news which excited us is short

explanation: that the appliance can be controlled 是 news 的内容。
verify: "The news that the appliance can be controlled remotely is exciting"

prompt: 想预测这项创新会节省时间，哪一句合适？

choices.text: I predict that will the innovation save time
I predict that the innovation will save time

explanation: predict that 后面用陈述语序。
verify: "I predict that the innovation will save time"

prompt: The new robot cooks by itself. The fact that its sensor failed yesterday explains the delay. The question is whether the network can be repaired today. 机器人会做什么？
explanation: 短文写 cooks by itself。

prompt: The new robot cooks by itself. The fact that its sensor failed yesterday explains the delay. The question is whether the network can be repaired today. 昨天什么部件出了故障？
explanation: 短文写 its sensor failed。

prompt: The new robot cooks by itself. The fact that its sensor failed yesterday explains the delay. The question is whether the network can be repaired today. 延误的原因是什么？
explanation: The fact that its sensor failed explains the delay。

prompt: The new robot cooks by itself. The fact that its sensor failed yesterday explains the delay. The question is whether the network can be repaired today. 作者还不确定哪一件事？
explanation: whether the network can be repaired 是还不确定的问题。

prompt: 要点：机器人会做饭、传感器昨天失灵、网络能否修好还未知。哪一句三个要点都有？

choices.text: The robot can cook, the sensor failed yesterday, and whether the network can be repaired is unknown

explanation: 三个要点都要出现。
verify: "The robot can cook, the sensor failed yesterday, and whether the network can be repaired is unknown"

prompt: 说明里用同位语从句，哪一句正确？

choices.text: The fact which the sensor failed explains the delay
The fact that the sensor failed explains the delay
The fact that failed the sensor explains

explanation: fact 的内容用 that 从句，that 不作成分。
verify: "The fact that the sensor failed explains the delay"

prompt: 哪一句适合作为步骤的第二句？

choices.text: Second, check whether the network are on
Second, check whether the network is on

explanation: Second 连接下一步，whether 从句用陈述语序。
verify: "Second, check whether the network is on"

prompt: 哪一句的表语从句是正确的？

choices.text: The problem is that does the appliance stop
The problem is why does it stop suddenly
Is the problem that stops it
The problem is that the appliance stops suddenly

explanation: that 从句用陈述语序 the appliance stops。
verify: "The problem is that the appliance stops suddenly"
